out.other_title: Assigned-role consultancy and debate with an LLM judge, compared with direct QA baselines
out.rationale: Kenton et al. define debate where a judge LLM answers after viewing two debater LLMs argue opposite answers, with 3 rounds by default. Engels et al.'s debate game is a 3-round debate modelled on Kenton et al., and they report judge (Guard) Elo rising with general intelligence while debater Elo stays flat on TruthfulQA, with similar behaviour on QuALITY and PrOntoQA.
out.scope: proposed DEPENDS_ON: debate scaling results that use a debate game modelled on Kenton et al.'s protocol

open_obligations: Do not read Engels et al.'s flat debater Elo as contradicting Kenton et al.'s debater-strength effect without matching metrics.
Note Engels et al.'s very small question sets.
Check whether both use the same notion of debater strength (cross-play Elo versus general Elo).
out.other_title: Debater strength (Elo) vs judge accuracy and correct-answer advantage in debate
out.rationale: Kenton et al. report stronger debaters (higher Elo) yield higher judge accuracy on extractive tasks with a Gemini Pro 1.5 judge, but are less differentiated on closed tasks. Engels et al. report that across models spanning the Chatbot Arena range, debater domain Elo stays flat with general intelligence while judge Elo rises, on TruthfulQA, QuALITY and PrOntoQA with 20 questions per dataset; they vary judge and debater together and measure Elo, not accuracy.
out.scope: proposed SAME_QUESTION_DIFFERENT_SETTING: how debater and judge capability shape debate outcomes for LLMs

text: The paper reports that on TruthfulQA, debater (Houdini) domain Elo stays constant with general intelligence while the judge's (Guard's) Elo scales with it, with similar behaviour on QuALITY and PrOntoQA and mostly flat performance for both roles on BoolQ; the authors read this as promising because an oversight-specialised judge may stay effective against very persuasive debaters.
title: In debate, judge (Guard) Elo rises with general intelligence while debater Elo stays flat
